**Step 2 — Vessel:** A shallow square plate, approximately 25 cm across. Using a circular-equivalent diameter of 25 cm gives an estimated area of **3.14 × 12.5² = 491 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** Leafy greens; small tan pieces that appear to be nuts; a tiny red vegetable garnish; visible oil-based dressing. The garnish identities are uncertain.

**Step 4 — Area:** Greens cover approximately 53%, tan garnish 1%, and red garnish 0.2%: **54.2% total coverage**. Dressing coats the greens rather than occupying additional plate area.

| Red vegetable garnish | 1 cm² × 0.4 cm = 0.4 ml | 0.6 g/ml → 0.2 g | 30 | <1 kcal |
| Oil-based dressing | Thin coating over ~260 cm² × 0.02 cm ≈ 5.2 ml | ~1 g/ml → 5 g | 600 | 30 kcal |

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **85 g and 57 kcal** is plausible for this airy mound of leaves with sparse garnish and light dressing. Dressing quantity and composition are the largest energy uncertainties.
